title: Usage of deprecated `ggplot2::aes_string()`
description:
When running the examples from `?prodplot` after setting `options(lifecycle_verbosity = "error")` I get the following error:

```
Error:
! `aes_string()` was deprecated in
  ggplot2 3.0.0.
ℹ Please use tidy evaluation idioms with
  `aes()`.
ℹ See also `vignette("ggplot2-in-packages")`
  for more information.
```

title: Unable to replicate examples from paper
description:
In the announcement paper [here](http://vita.had.co.nz/papers/prodplots.pdf), the following three code samples are provided, with the implication that they will reproduce figure 8 from the same paper.

```
prodplot(happy, ~ happy + finrela + health, c("vspine", "fluct"))
prodplot(happy, ~ happy | finrela + health, c("vspine", "fluct"))
prodplot(happy, ~ happy | finrela + health, c("hspine", "fluct"))
```

However, running the first example does not produce the same output.  Rather, the output plot looks like this:
![this](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13517868/39128548-59d470be-4708-11e8-8b25-206a70be530b.png)

The problems are:  
* x axis is numeric, rather than the category labels for `health`
* y axis shows the labels for `happy`, repeated for each level of `finrela`, rather than showing the labels for `finrela`
* the fill by `happy` is not done (but this can be added with `+ aes(fill = happy)` )

I would very much appreciate it if you could provide a code example for Figure 8 using the `productplots` package syntax.

title: backquoted variable names in prodplot
description:
There is an issue with backquoted variable names.
They work in formulas in prodplot, but they produce an error when they are used in aes (e,g, for specifying the fill color).

This works
```
library(tidyverse)
library(productplots)
set.seed(321321)
mydf <- data_frame(
V1=sample(letters[1:2],50,replace=TRUE),
`V 2`=sample(letters[24:25],50,replace=TRUE))
mydf %>%
  prodplot(~ `V 2` + V1)
```

But this then breaks:

```
mydf %>%
  prodplot(~ `V 2` + V1) + aes(fill=`V 2`)
```

title: Cannot add axis labels
description: `labs()` does not fully work on a `prodplot` object, likely because the aesthetics are set in a separate command instead of within the `prodplot()` call. `prodplot()` ignores x and y axis labels, but correctly uses title, subtitle, and caption: ``` r prodplot(happy, ~ happy + sex, mosaic("v")) + aes(fill=sex) + labs(x="Sex", y="Happiness", title="This is a title", subtitle="This is a subtitle", caption="And here's a caption") ```

title: Using the same data in other packages?
description:
Dear Hadley,

Would it be fine if I used the same GSS training data to illustrate functions in two other packages?
- `questionr` is a [package](https://github.com/juba/questionr) of helper functions for survey data (its only example dataset is in French)
- `ggtable` is an [ongoing submission](https://github.com/ggobi/ggally/pull/25) to the `GGally` package to plot frequencies and crosstabs

Please let me know if it would be fine for me to bundle your `happy.Rda` data extract into any of these packages.

Cheers,

François
